meta.title: After-Sales Service & Support | WashThru
meta.description: See WashThru's after-sales commitments — warranty coverage, multilingual support, spare parts availability, and our Basic, Remote Maintenance, Wash Cloud, and Full service plans.

hero.eyebrow: Support That Doesn't Stop at Delivery
hero.title: After-Sales Service & Support
hero.intro: From the day your machine is installed, WashThru stands behind it with warranty coverage, multilingual technical support, and a menu of service plans built around how you operate.

guarantees.heading: Our Commitments to You
guarantees.subheading: Five guarantees that come standard with every WashThru machine.

items.title: 2-year manufacturing warranty
items.description: 2 years warranty for the machine against all manufacturing defects and malfunctions (terms and conditions apply).

items.title: Support in your language
items.description: We guarantee that maintenance and technical support services are provided in multiple languages: English, Arabic, Urdu, and Filipino.

items.title: Hands-on operator training
items.description: We guarantee that the required training is provided to partners on how to operate and periodically maintain the machines, through our Comprehensive Training Department.

items.title: Spare parts always in stock
items.description: We guarantee that all main and consumable spare parts are always provided and made available.

items.title: Transparent cost planning
items.description: We guarantee our maximum cost calculation per vehicle. With our leading expertise in the car wash industry, we calculate expenses and depreciation by estimating the lifespan of each part, with an optional depreciation study per vehicle.

plans.heading: After-Sales Service Plans
plans.subheading: Choose the level of coverage that matches how you run your station.

tiers.name: Basic Plan
features: Vehicle activity reports — counts, entry times, sizes, and invoices, reviewed remotely over Wi-Fi
Wearable-parts lifespan tracker with advance replacement alerts
Smart maintenance system — full history of replaced parts, invoices, tickets, and visit reviews

tiers.name: Remote Maintenance Plan
tiers.tagline: Everything in the Basic Plan, plus:
features: Unlimited access to our maintenance video library
tiers.bonus: Includes 2 extra years of coverage at no charge

tiers.name: Wash Cloud Plan
tiers.priceNote: or 4,000 SAR billed annually (down from 800 / 8,000 SAR)
tiers.tagline: Everything in Remote Maintenance, plus full Wash Cloud access:
features: Smart auto-assistant for instant fault diagnosis
API integration for your own ERP or software
tiers.bonus: Includes 1 extra year of coverage at no charge

tiers.name: Full Plan
tiers.priceNote: Custom pricing based on your station
tiers.tagline: Everything in the Wash Cloud Plan, plus:
features: Frequent scheduled maintenance visits from our technicians
Option to extend your warranty up to 5 years
A free training course for your team
perks: Additional services included at no extra cost
tiers.bonus: Includes 6 months of coverage at no charge

cta.heading: Have questions about coverage?
cta.subheading: Our team can help you pick the right after-sales plan for your station.
